stats:
select count(name),
                sum(cls_count),
                sum(meth_count),
                sum(func_count),
                sum(imp_count),
                sum(cnst_count)

from api_surface
fanout:
with imported as (select 
            source as m_name,
            count(*) as n_imported
        from imports 
        where m_name like ?
        group by m_name),
        imports_ AS (
        select m.name as m_name,count(imp.id) as n_imports from imports imp 
        join modules m on m.id = imp.module_id
        group by imp.module_id),
		import_details AS (

       select m.name as module, coalesce(n_imports,0) as fanout,
            coalesce(n_imported,0) as fanin
        from modules m 
        left join imported on m.name = imported.m_name 
        left join imports_ on m.name = imports_.m_name)

select module, fanout from import_details
order by fanout desc limit 1;
fanin:
with imported as (select 
            source as m_name,
            count(*) as n_imported
        from imports 
        where m_name like ?
        group by m_name),
        imports_ AS (
        select m.name as m_name,count(imp.id) as n_imports from imports imp 
        join modules m on m.id = imp.module_id
        group by imp.module_id),
		import_details AS (

       select m.name as module, coalesce(n_imports,0) as fanout,
            coalesce(n_imported,0) as fanin
        from modules m 
        left join imported on m.name = imported.m_name 
        left join imports_ on m.name = imports_.m_name)

select module, fanin from import_Details
order by fanin desc limit 1;
decorator:
select name, count(id) as count 
from decorators
group by name 
order by count desc limit 1;
base:
select name, count(id) as count 
from bases
group by name 
order by count desc limit 1;
internal_imports:
with fname AS (
	select coalesce(source||'.','') || name as full_name 
from imports
)

select  
	full_name,
	count(*) as count
from fname
where full_name like :mod
group by full_name 
order by count desc
LIMIT 20
external_imports:
with fname AS (
	select coalesce(source||'.','') || name as full_name 
from imports
)

select  
	full_name,
	count(*) as count
from fname
where full_name not like :mod
group by full_name 
order by count desc
LIMIT 20
top_bases:
select  
	name,
	count(*) as count
from bases
group by name 
order by count desc
LIMIT 20
top_decorators:
select
        name,
        count(*) as count
from decorators
where function_id is not null
group by name
order by count desc
LIMIT 20
class_traits:
select 
(select count(class_id) from decorators) as is_decorated,
(select sum(is_contextmanager) from classes) as context_managers,
(select sum(is_descriptor) from classes) as descriptor,
(select sum(has_metaclass) from classes) as has_metaclass,
(select sum(is_iterable) from classes) as iterable,
(select sum(is_iterator) from classes) as iterator
function_traits:
select 
(select count(function_id) from decorators) as is_decorated,
(select sum(is_generator) from functions) as generator,
(select sum(is_async) from functions) as async_count
method_traits:
select
(select count(method_id) from decorators) as is_decorated,
(select sum(is_generator) from methods) as generator,
(select sum(is_async) from methods) as async_count
hubs:
with imported as (select
            source as m_name,
            count(*) as n_imported
        from imports
        where m_name like ?
        group by m_name),
        imports_ AS (
        select m.name as m_name,count(imp.id) as n_imports from imports imp
        join modules m on m.id = imp.module_id
        group by imp.module_id),
                import_details AS (

       select m.name as module, coalesce(n_imports,0) as fanout,
            coalesce(n_imported,0) as fanin
        from modules m
        left join imported on m.name = imported.m_name
        left join imports_ on m.name = imports_.m_name)

select *,(fanout + fanin)  as total from import_details
order by total desc limit 100;
api_surface:
select * from api_surface 
order by total desc limit 50
metaclass_graph:
with met as (
select m.name||'.'||c.name as name,metaclass from classes c 
join modules m on m.id = c.module_id
where metaclass is not NULL
) , met_path AS (select metaclass||'->'||path as entire_path,1+lvl as lvl from inheritance i  
join met m on m.name = i.ancestor
order by lvl desc
limit 1000) 

select entire_path from met_path
top_method_decorators:
select
        name,
        count(*) as count
from decorators
where method_id is not null
group by name
order by count desc
LIMIT 20
